params.name: bill_id

items.docs:
Enumerates disbursements recorded against a specific bill, useful when reconciling vendor statements to internal cash movements.
Combine with retrieve-a-bill to understand remaining balance after each payment posts.

params.name: bill_id
params.description: UUID of the bill to be used in this operation. Must match the `billId` provided in the request body.

items.docs:
Books a cash or scheduled disbursement that settles all or part of a bill, updating the outstanding payable and linking treasury activity.
Provide funding source details consistent with your configured payment rails so downstream bank reconciliation stays accurate.

items.docs:
Reverses a previously recorded bill payment when the disbursement failed or was duplicated, restoring the bill balance accordingly.
Treat this as a corrective action with the same controls you apply to voiding treasury transactions in your close process.
